# Migrated-surfaces list for the task-access drift check (ORCH-4-9-1).
#
# EMPTY at this landing: no contract surface has migrated to CLI-only access
# yet, so the check is trivially green on the unmigrated corpus. ORCH-4-9-2
# and ORCH-4-9-3 append one repo-relative path per migrated surface, per
# stage. A listed surface's discipline is strict: any non-fenced line
# naming .tasks must cite a `tasks <verb>` on the same line or carry the
# task-access-sanctioned marker, a status reserved for the retained
# research-deposit exception until a CLI research-deposit path lands and
# the exception is removed.
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line; blank lines and # comments are
# ignored. A listed path that does not exist is itself a finding. A
# permission-map-bearing surface (a charter or agent file with a YAML
# frontmatter permission stanza) is listed as `<path> @<role>`: its
# frontmatter is machine data and is map-diffed against
# tests/fixtures/task-access/tier-b/<role>.yaml above that config's
# fixture-denial-tail marker instead of being text-scanned; the body
# prose outside the frontmatter still follows the text patterns.
